column.spell: the spell itself — its name, what it says it does, its icon, and how it casts
column.id: the spell's own number, and the expansion that introduced it
column.model: the 3D models a spell draws — missiles, ground effects, attachments
column.sound: the sound files a spell plays, and the kits they come from
column.anim: how the character moves — replacements, kits, loose animations
column.fx: what the spell looks like — beams, glows, tints, morphs, size changes
column.mech: what the spell does — effects, auras, timing, links and gates

operator.exact: exactly this, matching the whole value
operator.glob: a pattern, where * stands for any run of characters
operator.regex: a regular expression between slashes, matched case-insensitively

type.text: words, matched anywhere in the text unless anchored with =
type.path: part of a file path; file names run words together, so bee also finds beer
type.enum: one of a fixed list of names; pick one, or type part of it
type.ordinal: a rung on a ladder; name one, or compare with < and >
type.count: how many, as a whole number or a comparison such as >4
type.seconds: a duration in seconds, such as 1.5, 500ms, or 2-5
type.percent: a percentage, such as 50 or 7.5, or a range like 10-90
type.percentChange: a change such as +50, a factor such as 2 or x1.5, or 150 as a proportion of the original
type.length: a distance in yards, such as 5 or 10-40
type.angle: an angle in degrees, such as 60 or 27-60
type.colour: a colour as #rrggbb or a name such as red; a bare colour matches nearby shades too
type.offset: a point as x,y,z in yards; name one member such as z=3, or leave a component blank to ignore it
type.bitmask: who it plays on: caster, target, both, area or others
type.flag: either the spell has it or it does not

target: who it plays on — caster, target, both, area, others

description.hint: what the spell says it does — its in-game description

icon.hint: the art on the spell's button — 272,900 spells share 9,846 icons

props.fid: the icon's file id — the number the ⧉ copies

delivery.hint: how the spell goes off — at once, behind a cast bar, or as a channel

props.cast: the cast bar's length in seconds, or instant for no bar at all
props.channel: the channel's length in seconds, or unlimited
props.breaksmove: the cast or channel breaks if the caster moves
props.unbreakable: the channel persists — moving and acting do not break it
props.unhindered: the caster can act during the channel (the usual interrupts still break it)

spellId.hint: the spell's own number — what .cast takes

expansion.hint: the expansion that introduced it — legion, >wotlk, <=mop

props.motion: the trajectory it flies — parabola, forward spin, follow ground

barrage.hint: a volley of models fired at once

props.attach: where the volley is fired from

ground.hint: a ground or area model laid on the world

attached.hint: a model stuck to the caster or the target

props.attach: where on the body it sits

trail.hint: a weapon trail that follows a swing

display.hint: a creature display model attached to the caster or target

item.hint: an in-game item's model, held by the caster

equipped.hint: a weapon the caster already has — main hand, off hand, ranged or ammo

props.slot: which slot — main hand, off hand, ranged, ammo

mount.hint: the mount the spell puts you on

sound.hint: a sound file the spell plays

props.kit: the sound kit, by name or by id

animKit.hint: an animation played through an AnimKit — the numbered bundles

props.boneset: which bones it drives — head, spine, arms

loose.hint: an animation the spell's visual kit plays directly, in no AnimKit

props.boneset: which bones it drives — head, spine, arms

replace.hint: an animation the spell swaps for another — Stand becomes StealthStand

pose.hint: holds the character's pose — the spell suppresses its own animation

passenger.hint: what a rider plays entering, sitting in and leaving a seat

props.sit: the animation held in the seat

chain.hint: a chain or beam effect held between two points

props.attach: where on the body it plays

shadowy.hint: a translucent shadow pass over the model

props.attach: where on the body it plays

ghost.hint: a ghost material swapped onto the model

props.attach: where on the body it plays

glow.hint: an edge glow or rim light around the model

tint.hint: a colour wash over the model

desaturate.hint: how much colour is drained from the model

freeze.hint: freezes or petrifies the model in place

morph.hint: a morph or transform aura — the caster becomes something else

props.display: the creature display, by name or by id

shapeshift.hint: a shapeshift form the caster takes

scale.hint: a size change the aura applies

props.amount: how much bigger or smaller: +50, x1.5 or 2 as a factor, 150 as a proportion

props.creature: the summoned creature, by name or by id

gameObject.hint: a gameobject the spell places — campfire, portal, banner, chest

props.object: the gameobject, by name or by id

screen.hint: a full-screen tint or overlay while the aura holds

tracking.hint: caster stays facing the target for the whole channel

effect.hint: one of the spell's effects — what it actually does

aura.hint: an aura the spell applies — what it does while it holds

triggers.hint: another spell this one casts, ticks, procs or removes

props.spell: the spell it triggers, by name or by id

origin.hint: a spell that casts, ticks, procs or removes this one

props.spell: the spell that triggers it, by name or by id

location.hint: where the spell refuses to cast — Epsilon enforces this gate on .cast

invis.hint: the invisibility channel the aura hides in

props.count: how many spells hide in that channel

seats.hint: the seats of the vehicle the caster becomes

props.count: how many seats the vehicle has
props.attach: where the seat sits on the vehicle

speed.hint: a movement-speed change — run, mounted, swim, flight or all at once

props.amount: how much faster or slower: +70, x1.7 or 2 as a factor, 170 as a proportion
props.mode: which movement: run, walk, fly or swim

keybind.hint: a key that casts a spell while the aura holds

debuff.hint: aura that shows in the red debuff frame
